title: Volleyball: Letran ousts San Beda from contention in Unity Cup
summary: Letran boosted its playoff hopes in the 2026 Shakey's Super League (SSL) Unity Cup on Friday after defeating San Beda University, 25-22, 25-14, 25-21, at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum.
